entities.name: Yasuda Zenjirō
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yasuda Zenjirō  was a Japanese entrepreneur from Toyama, Etchu Province who founded the Yasuda zaibatsu (安田財閥). He donated the Yasuda Auditorium  to the University of Tokyo. He was a maternal great-grandfather of Yoko Ono via his daughter Teruko, and adoptive son, Yasuda Zenzaburō (安田善三郎).
